subject: Mobile Development
title: Cross-Platform vs. Native Development
description: A micro-lesson that makes Cross-Platform vs. Native Development usable.

hook.text: Build one app for both iOS and Android — or build two separate apps. The debate never ends.

buildup.text: Cross-platform tools like React Native and Flutter let teams write code once for both platforms.

discovery.text: Native development offers better performance and platform-specific features but costs more.

twist.text: Many startups launch cross-platform to save money, then rebuild natively once they find product-market fit.

climax.text: The right choice depends on budget, timeline, and how much platform-specific behavior matters.

punchline.text: One codebase or two — every team must choose.

quiz.question: What is the advantage of cross-platform development?
options: One codebase works on both iOS and Android
